observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large wooden dance floor inside a hall with arched windows, surrounded by seated spectators.
observation.dancers: One couple at a time: a man and a woman in partner dance.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples dancing in pairs, traveling in a circular path around the large dance floor.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees slightly soft to allow smooth gliding steps, weight shifting continuously between feet.
observation.footwork: Gliding walking steps on the beat, stepping smoothly on the balls of the feet with heel lowerings, exact contact with floor not clearly visible due to video resolution.
observation.arms_and_hands: Closed ballroom dance hold, with the man's right hand on the woman's back and left hand holding her right hand up at shoulder level.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright and connected to the partner, hips moving naturally with the walking and turning steps.
observation.partnering: Close partnered dance with continuous physical contact in a standard closed ballroom frame, led by the man.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent smooth 360-degree rotational turns while traveling, no jumps or floor work visible.
observation.costume_and_props: Man wears a dark suit with a white shirt; woman wears a long flared red skirt and dark top.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and micro-weight shifts are obscured by low video resolution and distance.

signature_moments.what: Smooth forward and backward walking steps in closed hold, turning gradually while traveling around the floor.
Continuous paired rotational turns while moving in a circle.
A second couple performs sustained walking steps in close embrace.
The couple dips slightly on a slow beat while maintaining frame.
Rapid spinning turn with the woman's skirt flaring out as they rotate together.
